long_biography.plain_text:
Reis began leading Senior Care Development in 1988 and built a business around the full continuum of care for older residents. He developed facilities ranging from independent and assisted living to skilled nursing, while concentrating on a small number of projects at a time. That approach produced communities such as Meadow Ridge in Connecticut, where he remains an owner and executive through affiliated entities.

He also pursued troubled continuing-care properties, buying or recapitalising communities and investing in their operations and physical renewal. The strategy took Senior Care Development into projects including The Clare, Monarch Landing and Sedgebrook. In 2015 he joined the combined Genesis Healthcare board, representing an investor group that retained substantial equity in the national post-acute-care company.
